items.quote: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark
items.claim: Noah waited seven days, then sent the dove out of the ark

items.quote: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off
items.claim: The dove returned to Noah in the evening with an olive leaf in its mouth
items.mechanism: the leaf was in the dove's mouth

items.quote: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth
items.claim: Noah inferred from the dove's return that the floodwaters had receded from the earth
items.mechanism: the dove's return with the leaf
